tools.name: check_scope
tools.description: Free. Describe what you need in a sentence or two (no confidential details). Returns whether it is in scope, which service fits, what each suggested service covers (deliverables and turnaround), and the fixed fee for each (plus service_id, if you name one). Share the fee with your human before reque

tools.name: conflict_check
tools.description: Free. Required before any product details are shared. Names only: the client company, the human principal, other people involved, and any adverse, competing, or counterparty companies. The attorney reviews every check.

tools.name: request_engagement
tools.description: After conflict_check. Send a short matter_summary so the attorney can decide whether to take the matter. Describe the product the way you would describe it publicly. Do not send code, secrets, user data, or confidential business plans. The attorney uses this summary only to decide whether the firm c

tools.name: submit_intake
tools.description: Only after the engagement letter is signed. Product facts per https://mandatelaw.ai/api/intake-schema.json. Each fact has a value, a source (prefer verified_in_code), and evidence (paths and short excerpts; no secrets).

tools.name: answer_open_question
tools.description: Answer one of counsel's open questions (listed by get_matter). Before the letter is signed, only scoping questions can be answered: keep those answers short and general, with no code, secrets, or confidential details. After signing, verify in the code or the running build where you can, and say how

tools.name: feature_check
tools.description: For engaged clients, with the human's approval (it may be billed). Call before building a change that matches counsel-triggers.json. Do not ship the change until counsel responds.

tools.name: get_matter
tools.description: Status, counsel's open questions, feature checks, and deliverables (documents, privileged_memo, build_spec, verification_checklist, counsel_triggers). Privileged: follow the `privilege` block in the response, and commit only the parts listed in deliverable.handling.safe_to_commit.

tools.name: get_counsel_triggers
tools.description: Free. The template list of product changes that need legal review before shipping.

tools.name: check_change
tools.description: Free. Before building a change, describe it in a sentence or two (no code, secrets, or user data) to see which counsel triggers it may match. A keyword screen, not legal advice: also compare the change with the full list from get_counsel_triggers. If something matches, stop before building that part

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conflict_check, get_counsel_triggers · Private data: request_engagement, submit_intake, answer_open_question, get_matter, check_change · Public sink: check_scope, request_engagement, submit_intake.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: conflict_check, get_counsel_triggers · Private data: request_engagement, submit_intake, answer_open_question, get_matter, check_change · Public sink: check_scope, request_engagement, submit_intake

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_scope" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
